title: Providence Carriage | Gulf View 30a Vacation Rental – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: Offering Gulf views and 2 bedrooms, Providence Carriage is a vacation rental you don't want to miss! Click here to learn more and book a stay of your own today.
description_expanded:
Providence Carriage in Rosemary Beach is a 2 bedroom / 2 bath that offers a view of the gulf. Newly renovated for 2024, this lovely carriage features new bathrooms, new kitchen and updated bedding. This 3rd row carriage from the gulf is close to the Western Green and Pearl Hotel.

We provide passes to access all 4 Rosemary Beach Community pools, and any of the 9 Beach Walkovers

All towels, bed linens, blankets, comforters, and pillow/mattress protectors are professionally laundered for every new reservation!

Main Level: New Twin Bunk Beds with renovated bathroom and shower

Upper Level: New King Master Suite with new full bathroom & shower (semi-private loft)

*pack and play, and highchair included

Limited to 4 guests.

Heated/cooled space: 748 sq ft.

Large wrap around balcony.

This rare beach address is truly just steps to Main Street restaurants and the beach. A perfect location for easy family beach access or attending a wedding.

Pecky cypress ceilings, wood paneled walls, and rustic floors combine with a clean modern kitchen and bath to create a special retreat!

Features:

1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit. Passes for street parking additional or oversized cars provided.

* main level: Privacy pocket door between sink area and shower area.

* main level: kitchen and living room

* upper level: Large spacious semi-private master suite. Gulf View. Large TV.

* Kitchen: Sub Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, 4 burner cook top with oven.

* large 3 sided wrap around balcony with gulf and Pearl Hotel views.

* double balcony doors

* new furnishings

* new large washer/dryer in garage

* wireless internet

* flat panel TVs

*pack and play, and highchair included

No smoking.

No pets.

Luxurious appointments, professionally cleaned and managed.

The Barbados and Coquina Pools (seasonally heated) are a 3-5 min walk. Boardwalk G and H are literally steps away.

We look forward to hosting you!
